instruction: Candid street photograph, full shot at eye-level. On a city sidewalk next to a building with a red awning, the woman in the white jacket (R1) and the woman in the blue quilted sweater (R2) walk side-by-side. The woman in the white jacket (R1) walks on the left, wearing a brown scarf and carrying a black handbag, looking slightly down. The woman in the blue sweater (R2) walks on the right, holding a small checkered bag and looking warmly at her companion. The background is softly blurred under overcast daylight with cool tones.
